mutation_metadata.clean_form: During the winter expedition, the observatory records subtle changes in atmospheric pressure across the northern plateau each morning.
mutation_metadata.error_form: During the winter expedition, the observatory record subtle changes in atmospheric pressure across the northern plateau each morning.

items.answer_explanation: The singular subject observatory requires records, not record.
items.sentence: During the winter expedition, the observatory record subtle changes in atmospheric pressure across the northern plateau each morning.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: An ancient observatory preserves fragile star charts in climate-controlled cabinets near the western dome throughout the year.
mutation_metadata.error_form: A ancient observatory preserves fragile star charts in climate-controlled cabinets near the western dome throughout the year.

items.answer_explanation: The vowel sound at the start of ancient requires An, not A.
items.sentence: A ancient observatory preserves fragile star charts in climate-controlled cabinets near the western dome throughout the year.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: At the remote station, technicians carefully measure mineral density before recording the results in a shared laboratory ledger.
mutation_metadata.error_form: At the remote station, technicians careful measure mineral density before recording the results in a shared laboratory ledger.

items.answer_explanation: The verb measure requires the adverb carefully to describe manner.
items.sentence: At the remote station, technicians careful measure mineral density before recording the results in a shared laboratory ledger.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: The archive preserves specimens that the researcher examined before the curator returned them to a regional collection.
mutation_metadata.error_form: The archive preserves specimens who the researcher examined before the curator returned them to a regional collection.
mutation_metadata.mutation_type: object relative marker substitution: that -> who

items.answer_explanation: The relative marker refers to specimens as an object, so who is not the appropriate form.
items.sentence: The archive preserves specimens who the researcher examined before the curator returned them to a regional collection.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: Researchers found ceramic fragments preserved beneath the riverbank after the flood receded during the autumn survey.
mutation_metadata.error_form: Researchers found ceramic fragments preserving beneath the riverbank after the flood receded during the autumn survey.
mutation_metadata.mutation_type: reduced passive participle substitution: preserved -> preserving

items.answer_explanation: The fragments are passively preserved beneath the riverbank, so preserved is required.
items.sentence: Researchers found ceramic fragments preserving beneath the riverbank after the flood receded during the autumn survey.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: The digital catalog allows visitors to locate rare manuscripts without consulting the separate inventory maintained by the archive.
mutation_metadata.error_form: The digital catalog allows visitors locating rare manuscripts without consulting the separate inventory maintained by the archive.

items.answer_explanation: Allow visitors requires the infinitive to locate in this complement frame.
items.sentence: The digital catalog allows visitors locating rare manuscripts without consulting the separate inventory maintained by the archive.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: The revised policy requires local clinics to comply with reporting standards during annual inspections by regional auditors.
mutation_metadata.error_form: The revised policy requires local clinics to comply to reporting standards during annual inspections by regional auditors.
mutation_metadata.mutation_type: verb-preposition substitution: comply with -> comply to
mutation_metadata.minimal_correction: Change comply to to comply with.

items.answer_explanation: The verb comply takes the preposition with, not to, before reporting standards.
items.sentence: The revised policy requires local clinics to comply to reporting standards during annual inspections by regional auditors.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: The survey revealed how the current moved through the channel after the engineers adjusted the underwater gate.
mutation_metadata.error_form: The survey revealed how moved the current through the channel after the engineers adjusted the underwater gate.
mutation_metadata.mutation_type: embedded-question word order reversal: how the current moved -> how moved the current
mutation_metadata.minimal_correction: Change how moved the current to how the current moved.

items.answer_explanation: An embedded question uses statement order, how the current moved, rather than the reversed order.
items.sentence: The survey revealed how moved the current through the channel after the engineers adjusted the underwater gate.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: A series of controlled observations reveals seasonal changes in the river's temperature during extended drought conditions.
mutation_metadata.error_form: A series of controlled observations reveal seasonal changes in the river's temperature during extended drought conditions.
mutation_metadata.mutation_type: singular head agreement substitution: reveals -> reveal

items.answer_explanation: The singular head noun series requires reveals, even though observations is plural.
items.sentence: A series of controlled observations reveal seasonal changes in the river's temperature during extended drought conditions.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: The laboratory compared many samples from the upper valley before selecting representative specimens for chemical analysis.
mutation_metadata.error_form: The laboratory compared much samples from the upper valley before selecting representative specimens for chemical analysis.

items.answer_explanation: Samples is a plural count noun, so many rather than much is required.
items.sentence: The laboratory compared much samples from the upper valley before selecting representative specimens for chemical analysis.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: The stability of the bridge depends on regular inspections after heavy rainfall along the mountain road.

mutation_metadata.minimal_correction: Change depends of to depends on.

items.answer_explanation: The verb depend selects the preposition on, not of.
items.sentence: The stability of the bridge depends of regular inspections after heavy rainfall along the mountain road.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: The committee recommended that the museum preserve the mural in a temperature-controlled gallery near the central archive.
mutation_metadata.error_form: The committee recommended that the museum preserves the mural in a temperature-controlled gallery near the central archive.

items.answer_explanation: The mandative that-clause after recommended takes the base form preserve.
items.sentence: The committee recommended that the museum preserves the mural in a temperature-controlled gallery near the central archive.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: The revised filter is more reliable than the earlier device during repeated trials in the coastal laboratory.

items.answer_explanation: The explicit than comparison requires comparative more reliable, not superlative most reliable.
items.sentence: The revised filter is most reliable than the earlier device during repeated trials in the coastal laboratory.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: The engineers plan to measure soil moisture and compare the results during the afternoon field survey.
mutation_metadata.error_form: The engineers plan to measure soil moisture and comparing the results during the afternoon field survey.

items.answer_explanation: The infinitive plan coordinates measure and compare, so comparing breaks the forced parallel form.
items.sentence: The engineers plan to measure soil moisture and comparing the results during the afternoon field survey.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: Neither the instruments nor the calibration record explains the unusual readings recorded during the midnight inspection.
mutation_metadata.error_form: Neither the instruments nor the calibration record explain the unusual readings recorded during the midnight inspection.

items.answer_explanation: The nearer singular subject record requires explains in the neither-nor construction.
items.sentence: Neither the instruments nor the calibration record explain the unusual readings recorded during the midnight inspection.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: By the time the storm arrived, the crew had completed the coastal measurements and secured the instruments.
mutation_metadata.error_form: By the time the storm arrived, the crew has completed the coastal measurements and secured the instruments.

mutation_metadata.minimal_correction: Change has completed to had completed.

items.answer_explanation: The completed action precedes the past event arrived, so had completed is required.
items.sentence: By the time the storm arrived, the crew has completed the coastal measurements and secured the instruments.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: The committee postponed reviewing the survey results until the laboratory completed its final analysis.
mutation_metadata.error_form: The committee postponed to review the survey results until the laboratory completed its final analysis.

items.sentence: The committee postponed to review the survey results until the laboratory completed its final analysis.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: The composite remained stable under pressure during the extended heating test in the materials laboratory.
mutation_metadata.error_form: The composite remained stability under pressure during the extended heating test in the materials laboratory.

items.sentence: The composite remained stability under pressure during the extended heating test in the materials laboratory.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: These instruments detect faint signals from the deep-water sensors during the overnight calibration exercise.
mutation_metadata.error_form: This instruments detect faint signals from the deep-water sensors during the overnight calibration exercise.

items.sentence: This instruments detect faint signals from the deep-water sensors during the overnight calibration exercise.

mutation_metadata.clean_form: The updated procedure requires analysts to record every sample before the final report is released.
